maximum_depth_rule: All 1,500 Phase 9 Reviewed statements from the current Fukushima comprehensive plan are retained as raw maximum-depth records. Mixed source lines are not promoted into structured annual actual or future target values without reviewed field mappings.
disaster_boundary: Nuclear-accident, reconstruction, evacuation, decontamination, health, industry, and community-recovery statements remain source facts. Their inclusion does not imply recovery assessment, causal attribution, or comparison with other prefectures.
non_goals: Do not parse mixed raw statements into inferred annual actual and target values.
Do not convert disaster or reconstruction indicators into causal judgments.
Do not replace missing units or merge distinct statement rows.
Do not calculate achievement or cross-prefecture ranking.
